size.value: Minimum 400x600 pixels (digital upload minimum, not a fixed cm print size) -- per the Kurdistan Regional Government's e-Visa Portal, which issues a separate entry visa specifically for the Kurdistan Region of Iraq

background.value: Plain white or off-white background -- per the Kurdistan Regional Government's e-Visa Portal

headwear_policy.value: No hat or head covering that obscures the hair/hairline, unless worn daily for religious reasons; the full face must be visible with no shadows cast by the headwear -- per the Kurdistan Regional Government's e-Visa Portal

clothing_restriction.value: Uniforms should not be worn, except religious clothing worn on a daily basis -- per the Kurdistan Regional Government's e-Visa Portal

headwear.en: No hat or head covering that obscures the hair or hairline is permitted, unless worn daily for religious reasons; the full face must remain visible with no shadows cast by the head covering.
headwear.ko: 머리카락이나 헤어라인을 가리는 모자·머리가리개는 종교적 사유로 매일 착용하는 경우를 제외하고 금지되며, 머리가리개로 인한 그림자 없이 얼굴 전체가 보여야 한다.
headwear.ja: 髪やヘアラインを隠す帽子・頭を覆うものは、宗教上の理由で日常的に着用する場合を除き禁止され、それによる影がなく顔全体が見える必要がある。

clothing.en: Uniforms should not be worn, except religious clothing worn on a daily basis.
clothing.ko: 제복은 착용할 수 없으며, 일상적으로 착용하는 종교적 복장은 예외로 한다.
clothing.ja: 制服は着用不可。ただし日常的に着用する宗教的な服装は例外とする。

cross_verification.note_en: Iraq has two parallel visa-issuing authorities: the federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs (mofa.gov.iq), whose own visa page was directly fetched and states only 'two photographs' with no size/background/composition detail; and the Kurdistan Regional Government's e-Visa Portal (visit.gov.krd, a genuine .gov.krd domain), which publishes detailed digital-photo specifications for entry specifically to the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. The verified fields above are sourced to the KRG portal and are scoped accordingly -- they describe the KRG e-Visa, which may differ from a federal Baghdad-issued visa. Direct WebFetch of visit.gov.krd was blocked (403) on every attempt; confirmation relies on the domain appearing directly and repeatedly in web-search results with consistent figures across independent queries. DB's size value (3.5x4.5cm, a fixed print size) is not directly comparable to the KRG portal's pixel-minimum digital spec (different units/purpose), so no conflict is logged for size.
